nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end. Never interpret it.

body.description: Plain text, 1–280 Unicode code points, with a non-whitespace character.

bearerKey.description: Personal Unkey API key, not a root credential. Verified once by the gateway.

info.description: All /v1 operations require an Unkey Bearer key belonging to a verified account. Permissions are the intersection of gateway and local grants. No account or key management is available through this API. Text lengths count Unicode code points. Application errors and gateway errors have different envelopes; see docs/API.md.
info.title: Twitter clone social API

parameters.description: Own plus currently followed authors; opaque nextCursor, newest first
parameters.name: cursor

servers.description: Optional local Frontline gateway, not the browser port. Override for your environment.

x-gateway-errors.description: Frontline may reject a request before Rust. Its provider-owned error body is NOT ErrorEnvelope. Do not require requestId or an application error.code at the edge.
x-gateway-errors.retry: Honor gateway Retry-After when supplied. Never automatically replay a POST after an ambiguous transport or 5xx failure.
